import re
from collections import Counter

anagram_text = "In one of the Bard's tragedies, our persistent hero Hamlet wonders on two fronts about how life turns rotten and whether endurance outweighs action"

candidate = "Or to take arms against a sea of troubles and by opposing end them"

def normalize(s):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-z]', '', s.lower())

is_anagram = Counter(normalize(anagram_text)) == Counter(normalize(candidate))
print("Is perfect anagram:", is_anagram)
